overview: Deterministic E2E validation for artefact filtering, provenance visibility, unsafe labeling, and resilient download feedback.
successMetrics: All artefact rows expose provenance and safety status.
Download failures are explicit and recoverable.
uiNotes: Unsafe rows show explicit `UNSAFE` label with explanation.
Download actions expose loading and deterministic failure states.

importFormat.description: Scenario uses mixed artefact fixtures (csv/docx + safe/unsafe).

rules: Provenance must be visible on every artefact row.
Unsafe status must never be hidden from user.

stories.title: Filter and Download Artefacts with Provenance
stories.description: As an operator, I need artefact retrieval to include provenance and safety context before downloading outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given mixed artefacts are present, list renders provenance and safety metadata for each row.
When applying kind/type/unsafe filters, visible rows update deterministically.
Then download action provides clear loading and completion/failure feedback.
Example: unsafe filter shows only rows marked `UNSAFE` and explanation text is available.
Negative: expired signed URL yields deterministic error UX, not silent failed download.
